schema.textures: {name: {file (WebP <=512 px), source (game texture path), material (instance + parameter it came from), flipbook [cols,rows]?}}
schema.systems: {eventName: {kind ribbon|spray|burst|fx|bullet|alias, ...}}. kind fx = emitter list: {emitter (Niagara emitter it reproduces), layer, count (burst, data), rate (/s, data), delay, dur, life [a,b] s, size [s0,s1] m (with sizeCurve: s0+(s1-s0)*curve), speed [a,b] m/s, dir sphere|up|cone|radial|out|fwd|down|none, cone deg, shape point|sphere|disc|ring|body, radius m, height m, color linear RGB, alpha, gravity, drag, frames, frameRand, rotSpeed, stretch, alphaCurve/sizeCurve/colorCurve (curves{} names)}; system flags: timed (runs while the BANS_ notify window is active), ground (project to the floor), attach (follow the socket), scale; `tuned` lists the hand-tuned fields; ribbon systems may list `ribbons` (GunYing + distortion sub-ribbons)
schema.rawDumps: out/vfx/ng (systems), out/vfx/mat (materials), out/vfx/tex (PNG exports), out/vfx/bp (data assets/curves), out/vfx/niagara_summary.{json,txt} (decoded)
schema.layers: {name: SpriteLayer options {texture, blend normal|additive, ground, max, gain, bright, soft, distort (screen refraction UV offset)}}
schema.curves: {name: {lut (normalized age 0..1, stride floats per sample), stride, src}} resampled from the Niagara curve data interfaces (ShaderLUT)
schema.ghost: afterimage settings per BAN_GSGhost data asset
schema.post: screen pass settings per BAN_GSSpawnStaticMeshActor data asset (blur/glitch curves [[t, v]])
